City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
FEBRUARY 24, 2015
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Lewis, Holloway, Argudo, Klinakis and Muñoz
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Introduction of Sparks Elementary School Students Attending the City Council Meeting
Recognition of La Puente Warriors Jr. All American Pee Wee Cheerleading Squad
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF FEBRUARY 10, 2015
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of February 10, 2015.
A-1 Minutes 2-10-15 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO RESOLUTION NO. 06-4516 TO ESTABLISH FEES FOR PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT PERMITS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 15-5191 to amend the City's schedule of rates, fees and other charges for planning and development permits.
B-1 Planning & Development Fees Staff Report
B-1 Planning & Development Fees Resolution 15-5191
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
UPDATE AND DISCUSSION ON THE CITY'S STRATEGIC PLAN
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the update.
C-1 Strategic Plan Quarterly Update Staff Report
C-1 Strategic Plan Quarterly Update
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1380
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 15-1590 approving Warrant Register No. 1380.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1380
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. SA 15-46 APPROVING AN ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGET FOR THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY FOR FISCAL YEAR 2015-16
It is recommended that the Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. SA 15-46 approving the Successor Agency's Administrative Budget for the time period commencing July 1, 2015 and ending June 30, 2016.
D-2 Admin Budget Staff Report
D-2 Admin Budget Resolution SA 15-46
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. SA 15-47 APPROVING THE RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE (ROPS) COVERING THE PERIOD OF JULY 1, 2015 THROUGH DECEMBER 31, 2015
It is recommended that the Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. SA 15-47 approving the ROPS 15-16A for the six-month fiscal period commencing on July 1, 2015 and ending on December 31, 2015 and requesting approval of same by the Oversight Board.
D-3 ROPS Staff Report
D-3 ROPS Resolution SA 15-47
D-4
PRESENTATION AND DISCUSSION REGARDING THE SECOND QUARTER INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-4 2nd Quarter Investment Report Staff Report
D-4 2nd Quarter Investment Report Attachment A
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF PARTICIPATION IN A STORMWATER FUNDING OPTIONS STUDY THROUGH THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY DIVISION OF THE LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES AND THE CALIFORNIA CONTRACT CITIES ASSOCIATION AT A COST OF $7,500.00
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) approve the City's participation in joining with other Los Angeles County cities to jointly fund the study; and 2) authorize a budget amendment to transfer $7,500.00 from the Waste Management activity to the Engineering Services activity in the Community Development function.
D-5 Storm Water Funding Options Study Staff Report
D-5 Storm Water Funding Options Attachment A
D-5 Storm Water Funding Options Attachment B
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH SOUTHLAND TRANSIT INC. FOR FIXED-ROUTE AND DIAL-A-RIDE TRANSIT SERVICES IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $2,337,350
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Professional Services Agreement with Southland Transit Inc. for fixed-route and dial-a-ride transit services.
D-6 Southland Transit Staff Report
D-6 Southland Transit Attachment A PSA
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL - None
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this this 19th day of February, 2015
___________________________________
City Clerk
